detail.longDescription: API Testing Tutorial: GitHub User Info Learn to test APIs with real code examples. Getting Started We'll use GitHub's public API to fetch user information. No authentication required. Code Example (curl) curl -s "https://api.github.com/users/octocat" | jq . Response Analysis The JSON response contains: login : GitHub username id : User ID avatar_url : Profile picture URL html_url : Profile link Tips Use -s for silent mode (no progress bar) Pipe to jq for formatted JSON output Replace "octocat" with any GitHub username Conclusion API testing is essential for developers. This simple example demonstrates real-world usage. # python # api # testing # github # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community API Testing Tutorial: GitHub User Info
